''See also: [[Abidan Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Abidan is a vast, far-reaching organization dedicated to maintaining order across the cosmos. Originally emerging from the world of [[Cradle]], the group's foundation is tied to the first generation of its [[Court]] of Seven. The organization operates through various divisions, often headquartered in massive golden pyramids or on the central world of [[Sanctum]]. Their primary mission involves protecting [[Iterations]]—individual worlds within Way{{!}}the Way—from chaos and ensuring stability, though they are often criticized for being inflexible, acting solely in their own interest, or viewing local [[Monarchs]] as parasites. The Abidan's hierarchy includes the [[Court]] of Seven, led by [[Judges]] such as [[Makiel]], Judge Suriel{{!}}Suriel, and Ozriel. These high-ranking members possess significant Authority{{!}}authority, including the ability to intervene in mortal affairs and alter individual lives, provided they do not compromise a world's ultimate Fate{{!}}fate. The organization also utilizes specialized groups like the [[Wolf Division]] and the [[Reaper Division]], and maintains important locations such as [[Haven]], a prison-world, and [[Threshold]], a transitional world used to sort worthy [[ascendants]]. While the Abidan once managed ten thousand worlds, their influence has been severely compromised by the absence of key figures like Ozriel and attacks from enemies such as the [[Vroshir]]. This instability has left many sectors vulnerable to corruption and chaos. Despite their immense resources and ability to manipulate Way{{!}}the Way, the Abidan face internal dissent, most notably from The Mad King{{!}}the Mad King, formerly a high-ranking [[Executor]] named [[Daruman]], who seeks to dismantle the organization.}}

== Blackflame ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Operating from their headquarters in [[Sanctum]], the Abidan are a group that protects [[Iterations]] from chaos-tainted fragments found at the edges of Way{{!}}the Way. These entities, who wear smooth and entirely white armor, possess technology capable of generating stable domes that remain unaffected by chaos. During the events at [[Harrow]], they utilized these capabilities to evacuate the local elite. While their forces were once limited to caring for only two hundred and fifty [[Iterations]], they maintain a degree of autonomy when responding to temporal or spatial violations. Ultimately, the continued survival of the Abidan is dependent upon the presence of Ozriel.}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The Abidan is an organization that controls territory across existence, though they have abandoned nine hundred and ninety sectors to focus on ten remaining ones. Currently stretched to their absolute limits, they receive reports from agents and messages sent through Way{{!}}the Way Between [[Worlds]]. This group includes the [[Phoenix Division]] and seven greatest assets, among whom Ozriel is considered by some to be the most valuable [[Judge]]. While they utilize [[Haven]] as a prison-world and possess an unstoppable [[sword]], they also gifted [[Penance]] to [[Yerin]]. The Abidan is composed of peers to [[Eithan]] who may potentially imprison him, leading others to question their arrival or their ability to wipe memories.}}

While their iron-and-crystal manacles{{!}}manacles can act as a beacon to any member of the order, the Abidan are currently opposed by the [[Vroshir]] and have faced defiance from figures like [[Northstrider]]. == Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Abidan is a far-reaching human organization composed of various divisions that supervise and protect worlds. Headquartered within great golden pyramids, these members possess special Authority{{!}}authority over Way{{!}}the Way and can even lock down a world. While many workers view them as divine beings, the organization is currently shorthanded and faces significant challenges, such as Class Three [[Fiends]] that can oppose entire groups of their members. Having occupied [[Threshold]] since the first generation, they are permitted to use their full power there and consider the Reaper{{!}}Reapers to be traitors. During recent events, an Abidan woman wearing armor with a curled-up fox symbol assisted in [[Lindon]]'s transport, and the organization issued warnings to both [[Lindon]] and [[Yerin]] as they emerged from a [[Way-portal]].}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|“Did you promise the Abidan your service?” the Dragon King asked.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c2" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Especially if that “someone” was a low-ranking Abidan who saw everyone still in Cradle as misguided infants.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c21" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|“It seems the Abidan’s oath of noninterference is worth only as much as they decide it is,” Reigan Shen said.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c19" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|“The Abidan hate the Monarchs,” Malice said bitterly. “They consider us…parasites.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|“Who wants a weapon made by Ozriel?” the Abidan asked, dangling an arrowhead.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c14" />}}
